title: Concatenation of computation segments
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $F$ be a set of states, and let $P$ be a property of work-tape head positions. If a run from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps and avoids $F$ before time $t$, and a run from $b$ reaches $c$ after $v$ steps and avoids $F$ before time $v$, with $P$ holding on the work-tape head positions throughout both segments, then the run from $a$ reaches $c$ after $t+v$ steps, avoids $F$ at every time before $t+v$, and satisfies $P$ at every time through $t+v$.

The first run avoids $F$ at every time before $t$

The second run avoids $F$ at every time before $v$
The second run satisfies $P$ at every time through $v$
